title: Image to 3D Converter
tagline: Upload an image and get an interactive 3D model you can download.
overview: An AI-powered web app that turns a single image into an interactive 3D model. You upload a picture, the server generates the model with the Neural4D API, and the result opens in a 3D viewer in your browser.
problem: Making a 3D model by hand takes specialist software and hours of work. I wanted anyone to be able to get a usable 3D model from one picture.
solution: A Node.js backend that receives the upload, sends it to the Neural4D API and waits for the result, plus a Three.js viewer that displays the model and lets you download it as a .glb file.
features: Upload PNG, JPEG or WebP images up to 10 MB
3D model generation with the Neural4D API
Interactive viewer with orbit, pan and zoom
Mesh resolution, texture quality and output format settings
challenges: Generation is asynchronous, so the server checks Neural4D every 4 seconds and stops after 5 minutes. Neural4D's result links are temporary, so the server downloads each finished model and serves it from its own storage.
result: A complete pipeline from image upload to a downloadable, interactive 3D model.

gallery.caption: Interactive 3D viewer with orbit, pan and zoom, plus live vertex and face counts
Input image preview, with mesh resolution, texture quality and GLB output settings

title: AI Chatbot
tagline: A simple chatbot you can talk to and ask questions.
overview: A browser-based chatbot powered by Google's Gemini API. You type a question and get a conversational answer.
problem: Talking to an AI should feel simple: type a question, get an answer, with nothing to set up for the person using it.
solution: A chat interface in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript that sends your messages to the Gemini API and shows the replies in the chat.
features: Ask questions and chat in natural language
Answers generated by the Gemini API
Lightweight: plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript
challenges: Connecting the interface to the Gemini API and handling each request and response. Next step: move the API key to a small backend so it is never exposed in browser code.
result: A working chatbot that answers questions in real time.

title: Portfolio Website
tagline: This site: animated, responsive and backed by a real database.
overview: My personal portfolio, built with a Node.js server and MongoDB so projects and client messages are managed in a database.
problem: A portfolio has to be quick to scan, work on every screen, and make it easy for clients to reach me.
solution: A single-page site with scroll-driven animation, a case-study viewer, and a contact form that saves every message to MongoDB and alerts me on WhatsApp.
features: Animated hero, project case studies and skill tabs
Contact form saved to MongoDB with spam protection
WhatsApp alert for every new message
challenges: Balancing animation with performance and accessibility: motion is reduced for visitors who ask for it, and every interaction works with a keyboard.
result: A fast, responsive portfolio where every client message is stored and sent straight to my WhatsApp.
